name: What types of pipe materials are used for water line replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of pipe materials are used for water line replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pipe materials used for water line replacement include copper, PEX (cross-linked polyethylene), and sometimes PVC (polyvinyl chloride). Copper is durable and resistant to corrosion but can be more expensive. PEX is flexible, cost-effective, and resistant to freezing and corrosion. PVC is primarily used for larger main lines or specific applications. Alpha-Plumbing Services helps you choose the best material based on your budget, water quality, and local regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water lines typically use copper, PEX, or PVC. Each material has different benefits regarding durability, flexibility, and cost.
